declarations.name: Div
declarations.summary: A div that takes the classes of relayout.css through class, inside another component's shadow root.
declarations.description: Inside another component's shadow root, the page's relayout.css doesn't apply. <rl-div class="rl-row rl-gap-m"> carries the rules of its classes with it, and is there what <div class="rl-row rl-gap-m"> is in the page. It takes every class of relayout.css, and the page loads relayout.css, which holds the sizes and colors. See https://relayout.net/docs/web-components/.

attributes.description: The classes of relayout.css, as on a div: rl-row rl-gap-m.
